answer: Limit each hardware security module to one active agent key per epoch. An attestation service checks the module's manufacturer certificate and rejects duplicate registrations. A public beacon supplies fresh nonces; signed replies signal live possession. Reused proofs fail, and revoked devices lose voting rights. The admission ledge is physical hardware: 1,000 aliases require 1,000 certified modules, even in parallel. This assumes trustworthy issuers and non-exportable keys; compromised issuers break the bound.
